query: WITH total_population_by_region AS (SELECT hl.region, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS total_pop FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala AS hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location AS hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.snapshot = '2026-01-29' AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE AND NOT hl.region IS NULL AND TRIM(hl.region) <> '' GROUP BY hl.region), citizen_population_by_region AS (SELECT hl.region, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS citizen_pop FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala AS hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location AS hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.snapshot = '2026-01-29' AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE AND hp.person_type = 'Saudi' AND NOT hl.region IS NULL AND TRIM(hl.region) <> '' GROUP BY hl.region) SELECT t.region, t.total_pop, c.citizen_pop, ROUND((c.citizen_pop * 100.0 / t.total_pop), 2) AS citizen_percentage FROM total_population_by_region AS t JOIN citizen_population_by_region AS c ON t.region = c.region ORDER BY t.total_pop DESC LIMIT 1200
